title: Inventory deductions via fulfillment outbox and pg-boss consolidation

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every shipped lifecycle command creates durable inventory-deduction intent transactionally; the fulfillment outbox owns lease recovery, bounded retries, and settlement while canonical inventory ledger keys make worker re-entry exactly once.

When INVENTORY_AUTO_DEDUCT is off, the canonical owner returns before opening a transaction, the outbox retains unresolved work, and the new bounded read-only report classifies every unresolved row as parked_kill_switch with zero deduction writes. Authenticated internal operators can access the projection through GET /inventory/deduction-outbox-report.

Recurring fulfillment work remains owned by pg-boss schedules with singleton admission, stale-processing lease recovery, one scheduler owner, and inventory-event failure/success isolation from marketplace and order projections.

Injected rollback, concurrent worker retry, restart, torn settlement, and stale-worker scenarios converge to one durable intent and one inventory-ledger effect without duplicate provider, marketplace, stock, or package effects.

PS-247, PS-413, PS-414, PS-424, PS-432, inventory source-of-truth, inventory auto-deduct, sync admission, typecheck, production build, and all 51 mandatory source-of-truth commands pass at the reviewed SHA.
The exact reviewed SHA is live on the Render production API and fulfillment worker; public health and readiness return HTTP 200, and GitHub scheduled zero Actions runs.

canonicalOwners: src/services/order-lifecycle-command.ts owns immutable shipped-transition facts and exact fulfillment-line claims
src/services/fulfillment/inventory-deduction-outbox.ts owns durable inventory intent, dedupe keys, recovery, and delegation
src/services/fulfillment-deductions.ts remains the unchanged canonical kill-switch, stock-movement, and ledger-idempotency owner
src/services/fulfillment/outbox.ts owns claim leases, retries, failure state, and settlement
src/services/sync-job-queue.ts owns pg-boss cadence and singleton admission
src/services/fulfillment/inventory-deduction-report.ts owns only the bounded SELECT projection over unresolved work
src/routes/inventory.ts is a thin authenticated internal transport that validates the report limit and delegates to the report owner

wrappers.delegatesTo: inventory-deduction-report.ts and the validated env.INVENTORY_AUTO_DEDUCT value; it owns no mutation or retry policy

sotBypass.details: The report reads backend outbox truth and the validated runtime switch. It does not calculate stock, mutate a ledger, retry work, settle outbox rows, or reproduce lifecycle policy.

evidence.proves: The kill switch precedes any inventory transaction; disabled work throws back into durable retry state; stale processing claims are recoverable; inventory settlement cannot update marketplace/order confirmation projections; pg-boss scheduling and singleton admission remain present; the report contains SELECT only; and its route is internal-authenticated, bounded, and delegates to the canonical report owner.

An injected transaction spy remains at zero with INVENTORY_AUTO_DEDUCT=false. A PostgreSQL-compatible fixture classifies pending, processing, retrying, exhausted, and kill-switch-parked rows, excludes succeeded/unrelated work, preserves lifecycle identity, and is byte-for-byte unchanged after repeated report reads.

Concurrent lifecycle delivery and concurrent worker application produce one immutable claim and one stock effect; repeat worker application is a no-op; injected claim-boundary failure rolls state, receipt, claims, and outbox back together; split shipments and void/relabel sequences preserve exact quantities.

Injected transaction loss, concurrent duplicate inventory intent, provider acknowledgement before local persistence, torn settlement, restart, and stale-worker scenarios recover without missing work or duplicate inventory/provider effects.

migrations.rollbackPlan: No schema or data rollback is required. Forward-revert the PS-450 implementation and packet commits if the report causes an operator regression; never delete outbox, lifecycle, shipment, order, inventory, ledger, or package history.

rollback.strategy: Forward-revert implementation commits 05f9fadc0dc992cd2b7753ad7aab4403d22029a3 and 93c095b3ed1739fa9148ea61ed206eda8f06dfda plus their packet commits, then deploy the reviewed revert to the API and fulfillment worker. The report is read-only and has no schema, provider, or data side effect, so rollback must not mutate application rows or replay fulfillment work.
